# Flowers In Action

Premium florist and flower delivery service in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Business

Flowers In Action is a physical flower shop and WhatsApp-based ordering florist located at Plaza 24, B Block Bankers, Ground Floor, Lahore — near DHA Phase 4, State Life Housing Society and Lake City.

## Services

- Fresh floral bouquets
- Floral boxes and gift boxes
- Floral and chocolate bouquets
- Gift baskets
- Money bouquets
- Crochet flowers
- Bridal bouquets
- Floral jewellery and gajra
- Groom garlands
- Wedding car decoration
- Room decoration
- Birthday flower delivery
- Anniversary and romantic flowers
- Same-day flower delivery (subject to confirmation)
- Custom floral designs via WhatsApp

## Delivery

Flower and gift delivery available across Lahore including DHA, State Life, Bankers Town, Lake City, Valencia Town, Wapda Town, Johar Town and Khayaban-e-Amin.

## Ordering

Orders are placed via WhatsApp. No online card checkout. A 10% advance payment is typically required to confirm delivery and customised orders.
